SNODAS water year 2027 covers October 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027. Snow water equivalent (SWE) is modeled snowpack water, not daily snowfall. The maps use the latest verified regional data available, which may lag today's date.

**Latest map date: October 7, 2026**

![](../maps/generated/snodas/current/swe-departure.png){fig-alt="Snow water equivalent departure from the seasonal median"}

::: {.archive-map-description}
Observed SWE minus the centered-five-day WY2005-WY2025 median for this calendar date, in inches. Positive values indicate more snow water than the reference median.
:::

::: {.dashboard-card-actions}
[Open full-resolution PNG](../maps/generated/snodas/current/swe-departure.png){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::
:::

::: {.dashboard-map-card}
![](../maps/generated/snodas/current/swe-percent-median.png){fig-alt="Snow water equivalent as a percent of the date-specific median"}

::: {.archive-map-description}
Observed SWE divided by the centered-five-day WY2005-WY2025 median, times 100. Ratios require a median of at least 1 inch and at least 18 reference years. Gray indicates a valid median below 1 inch; beige indicates unavailable data or insufficient reference support. This is not a percentile.
:::

::: {.dashboard-card-actions}
[Open full-resolution PNG](../maps/generated/snodas/current/swe-percent-median.png){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::
:::

:::

Seven-day SWE change unavailable (2026-09-30 to 2026-10-07): Exact prior endpoint is missing or unverified. No date substitution or zero filling is used.
SNODAS is a modeled 06:00 UTC snowpack snapshot supplied by NOAA/NSIDC.
The departure is an absolute difference, not a percentile or snowfall total.
